description: This file defines a class for transforming graph modules by functionalizing side-effectful operations in PyTorch's export pipeline. It includes methods for processing graph nodes, replacing certain operations with functional versions, and managing dependency tokens.

classes.name: _FunctionalizeSideEffectfulOpsPass
classes.description: A class that replaces side-effectful operations in a graph module with their functional counterparts, managing dependency tokens during the process.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the pass, setting up dependency token attributes.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Processes a graph module, performing a deep copy and checking for relevant nodes before applying transformations.

methods.name: call_operator
methods.description: Replaces specific operators with their functional versions, managing dependency tokens and node metadata.

methods.name: output
methods.description: Generates the output ProxyValue, including the dependency token.
